name: Amazon AWS S3
tagline: Connect an Amazon Web Services S3 bucket via IAM Access Key and Secret.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: AWS Console › IAM › Users › Security Credentials › Create Access Key
instructions.step1: Open the AWS Management Console and navigate to IAM.
instructions.step2: Create an IAM Access Key for your user or application.
instructions.step3: Enter your Access Key ID, Secret Access Key, region, and bucket name.
